name: Nickel
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was only obtainable from the "Doping" bundle for Summer Sport Games celebrations.
If you get two players that own this paint right next to each other, it's called a Dime.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.

Garage description
A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
The paint appeared on July 16th, 2021.
This paint was only obtainable from the "Doping" bundle for Summer Sport Games celebrations.
If you get two players that own this paint right next to each other, it's called a Dime.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
